subject: Extra figure being placed when plotting phylogenetic trees using 'ape' package

messages.author: 2b295401a3ad4073
messages.subject: Extra figure being placed when plotting phylogenetic trees using 'ape' package
parts:
I have been trying to embed phylogenetic trees, using the ape package, in a knitr Rmd document. I always end up with an empty figure placement next to the actual figure being correctly plotted. I searched but could not find any documentation for this bug. An example is below. Any help in this would be greatly appreciated. 

```{r,fig.height=2,fig.width=2}
library(ape)
phy <- rtree(5)
plot(phy,no.margin=TRUE)
```

This results in this output: 

Or sometimes when there is an additional figure later in the document, it will be placed in the empty spot instead?

Thanks!
James

messages.author: 5eafd1ef6d900b85
messages.subject: RE: [knitr] Extra figure being placed when plotting phylogenetic trees using 'ape' package
parts:
This appears to be a result of `plot.phylo` opening two devices - perhaps due to the way it saves components of the last recorded plot.


A short term work around would be to use `fig.keep = 'last'`,

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Extra figure being placed when plotting phylogenetic trees using 'ape' package
parts:
This is a bug of the evaluate package, and I just fixed it. Please
test the development version here:

install.packages('evaluate', repos='http://www.rforge.net/', type='source')

Of course, fig.keep='last' also works.

Regards,
Yihui
